name: Flametouched
description:
Like the trees of the Rauðkorna, you have taken on the aspect of flame.

You can conjure, manipulate and snuff out flames up to the size of a campfire at-will. Your eyes glow like embers and your body emits faint smoke whenever you do this.

Once per rest, when you hit with a melee attack, you may augment the hit with a burst of fire: add 1d4 to the damage roll.

Describe your power over fire.
